read_from: 78-page multi-discipline set; the cover's drawing index lists fourteen electrical sheets (ES100 .. E800), which are pages 55-68. Every one of those pages is rotation 270 with ZERO text -- no fonts, no words: the text was outlined to paths when the PDF was made. The title blocks are legible in a render (ES100 ELECTRICAL SITE PLAN on page 55) but nothing on them can be read as text, so per the fixture rules each is recorded with an empty number and is asserted NOT detected. The pages the engine used to pick instead (0 cover G0.00, 31 A5.03, 37 A6.01, 42 M1.01, 46 M6.01) are non-electrical pages whose body tags (EQ020, EF-7) or drawing index landed in an edge strip
